questions.question: If A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B, A × B means that A is the sister of B, A – B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc18661538b8e760eee8089ba610d654eec8f61da9a77c27517f531b78869fe6.png] 

**Given :**

 
 

 Code
 Meaning
 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A × B
 A is the sister of B
 
 

 A – B
 A is the father of B
 
 

**Given Statement:** P is the father of R.

**Option 1**: P – Q × R

P – Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

Q × R means ‘Q is the sister of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a65b455ba77be6452968de8fb3d9736135d37e8f6f9ccd1de42a1ae0c91746.png] 

Here, P is the father of R so it will be answer.

**Option 2 :** P × Q – R

P × Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’.

Q – R means ‘Q is the father of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bdbb3564cda64ba097df139137679be8f18499fec9212a263d4c08fbb5d076.png] 

P is the aunt of R.

**Option 3**: P ÷ Q × P

P ÷ Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

Q × R means ‘Q is the sister of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a1991ac21899dc6bbddaf9d05ef0badd263a9b8b3720b5be77b538bc4788f32.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R.

**Option 4 : **P ÷ Q – R

P ÷ Q means ‘P is the bother of Q’.

Q – R means ‘Q is the Father of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a56891dbaa847439bca6b9e5a734debb740290c272b2a5b98500673665ba66a7.png] 

Here, P is the paternal uncle of R.

Hence, **'Option 1'** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B, A × B means that A is the sister of B, and A – B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal uncle of R?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png]

A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B

A × B means that A is the sister of B

A – B means that A is the father of B

 **Symbol Denoted Relation**

**Find:- **Which expression shows that P is the paternal uncle of R.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P - R ÷ Q

P is the father of R, and R is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ac848a71c2943eea2b92826cb964bdd84a8e3b8ec02013b0a1674510fb49339.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4dec5627f20e2b4561c8729038ba5601b338911b7e91f300f9ea96a38bd0f7d.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **P × R - Q 

P is the sister R, R is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e752c4f022c65e1f91daddc01ed32e48e88bdb70d51faa45de85c446b2d7a6c3.png] 

Here, P is the Sister of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P ÷ Q - R

P is the brother of Q, Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07a1622d388e918cd61b4637b94c89e8d6b4c88bebb8f8969e8a4b4089874d8.png] 

Here, P is the Paternal uncle of R. (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

**Option 2) P – Q + R** means,

**Here, P is the mother R.**

Option 3) P – Q ÷ R means,

P is the mother of Q, Q is the father of R

Here, P is the grandmother of R.

Option 4) R + P – Q means,

R is the brother of P, P is the mother of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e812658c1766616499477cec8be9474763349cb51520f8bf70b2baeaf7073049.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘B is the son of A’.

If F & G @ H # I @ J, then how is G related to J?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Given statement :** F & G @ H # I @ J**

So,

 
• F & G → F is the father of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aeaa99ea28c600f729965ea6640bdeaf916575606b5721a71f557e98f958c90.png] 

 
• G @ H → G is the husband of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d32214ce03b274e43ec7dd4bd79f0416e9062bd1369f6e6c3d2393f42e30f91b.png] 

 
• H # I → I is the son of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b76e2489a9448a12d39fb7baa16a0a212298581a14f3248555c4956b7d041cc6.png] 

 
• I @ J → I is the husband of J.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b700de5184c760b87b768c1ff502f72cf804496405280159d24c0fcbb7c1c23e.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree G is the father-in-law of J.

Hence, **"Father-in-law**" is the correct answer.
